The hook is used directly in two patient-chart workspace forms, and through them in four functions in the lab-results resource and one in the vitals data resource. Those are the code paths a behaviour change would reach.

**Direct users of `useAbortController`**

- The definition is `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useAbortController.ts:25-38`. It returns one `AbortController` per component instance, replaces it only if the current one is already aborted, and aborts it on unmount. That unmount abort is the behaviour most likely to change.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/lab-results/exported-lab-results-form.workspace.tsx` takes the controller at line 70 and passes it to every save-path request. These are `fetchSavedLabResults` (line 254), `completeOrderWithSavedResults` (line 304) and `updateOrderResult` (line 338). If the controller were aborted on unmount, or stopped being replaced, these saves would fail with an abort error, which the handler surfaces as an error notification.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/exported-vitals-biometrics-form.workspace.tsx` takes the controller at line 87 and passes it to `createOrUpdateVitalsAndBiometrics` in the submit handler (lines 225-267). The success path then closes the workspace and shows a snackbar, and the error path shows an error snackbar.

**Functions that receive the controller and pass its `signal` to `openmrsFetch`**

- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/lab-results/lab-results.resource.ts:265-272`, `fetchSavedLabResults`.
- Same file, lines 278-296, `updateOrderResult`.
- Same file, lines 302-325, `completeOrderWithSavedResults`.
- Same file, lines 327-336, `updateOrderFulfillerDetails`, which is the last request in both save paths.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/data.resource.ts:527-553`, `createOrUpdateVitalsAndBiometrics`.

**Likely affected, not verified**

- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/vitals-biometrics-form.test.tsx` has `signal` assertions at lines 280 and 437. I did not read the surrounding code, so I can't say whether they depend on abort behaviour or only on the presence of a signal.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/mock.tsx:108` and `mock-jest.tsx:103` mock the hook for tests. Any test that relies on the mock mirroring real behaviour would be affected, but I have not checked which tests do.

**Not checked**

- I searched references only in `openmrs-esm-patient-chart`. The other 12 `openmrs-esm-*` repositories listed by Falkon were not searched, so any other app using the hook is not covered here.
- Dynamic use, such as re-exports through `@openmrs/esm-framework` in other packages, would not show up in name searches.
- I did not read the lab-results and vitals test files, so I have not confirmed how they exercise the controller.
